endgame.title: Endgames
endgame.subtitle: Practice classic endgames against Stockfish
endgame.stalemate: Stalemate! Be careful — pushing too hard can trap the opponent.
endgame.draw: Draw. Try to be more precise.
endgame.pos_kq_goal: Checkmate the black king with queen and king. A fundamental mate every chess player must know.
endgame.pos_kq_tip: Use the queen to cut off the king's escape squares, then bring your king closer for support. Be careful — placing the queen too close can create stalemate!
endgame.pos_kr_goal: Checkmate the black king with rook and king. Apply the staircase technique.
endgame.pos_kr_tip: The rook cuts off the king's movement along a rank, your king approaches. Step by step, push the opponent's king to the edge.
endgame.pos_kbb_goal: Checkmate with two bishops. One of the hardest basic mates.
endgame.pos_kbb_tip: Two bishops act as a barrier. Push the king into a corner where the bishops control both color squares.
endgame.pos_kbn_goal: Checkmate with bishop and knight. The hardest basic mate.
endgame.pos_kbn_tip: Mate is only possible in the corner controlled by the bishop. Use the W-technique — the knight transfers the king from one corner to another.
endgame.pos_pawn_goal: Promote a pawn to a queen and checkmate the opponent.
endgame.pos_pawn_tip: The king goes ahead of the pawn. Remember opposition — when kings face each other with one square between them, it's decisive.
endgame.pos_rook_goal: Rook endgame — learn the Philidor and Lucena positions.
endgame.pos_rook_tip: Philidor: rook on the 6th rank as a barrier. Lucena: the bridge-building technique.
endgame.pos_queen_goal: Queen endgame with pawns — precise play is critical.
endgame.pos_queen_tip: Queen endgames often lead to perpetual checks. Look for opportunities to exchange queens and transition to a winning pawn endgame.
endgame.pos_bishop_goal: Bishop endgame — good and bad bishops.
endgame.pos_bishop_tip: A bishop is strong when the opponent's pawns are on its color squares. Try to create a breakthrough.
endgame.pos_rook_pawn_goal: Rook vs pawn — can the pawn promote?
endgame.pos_rook_pawn_tip: If the pawn is too far advanced, the rook can't stop it. A series of checks must be sufficient for the king to help.
endgame.result_stalemate: Stalemate! Be careful — pushing kings too close can tie the opponent.
